DeliveryStatus.description: DeliveryStatus: 1 = Scheduled, 2 = Packed, 3 = Routed, 4 = OutForDelivery, 5 = Delivered, 6 = Failed, 7 = Canceled.

DispatchStage.description: DispatchStage: 1 = NothingToDispatch, 2 = ReadyToSend, 3 = SentAwaitingRoutes, 4 = PartiallySent, 5 = RoutesPublished, 6 = PulledBack.

LineOrderStatus.description: LineOrderStatus: 1 = Pending, 2 = Ordered, 3 = PartiallyReceived, 4 = Received, 5 = OutOfStock, 6 = Substituted, 7 = Shorted.

RouteStatus.description: RouteStatus: 1 = Planned, 2 = Published, 3 = Executing, 4 = Completed, 5 = Canceled, 6 = Unpublished.

Bearer.description: The access token returned by POST /api/auth/login, as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It is short-lived: on a 401, call POST /api/auth/refresh-token — which authenticates with the httpOnly refresh cookie, so that call needs credentials included and no bearer header — then retry once.
